verdict.rationale: Delegating compliance filings to an agent is a fair question for a startup legal-paperwork platform, but nothing in the evidence shows an agent can prepare annual reports or compliance filings through Clerky. The remote MCP server is described as offering read-only, team-scoped tools, so an agent could not prepare a filing through it. The Partner API covers only Delaware C-Corp formations, and its OAuth access is still listed as coming soon. The only filing-related item is human-driven online IRS form submission, with no agent path.
